name: EPIC 204942683
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 10.2 solar radii and 0.90 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,037 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.90 solar masses and 10.2 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,821 K at its surface.
